rationale: The agent executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) and stated the charge would be applied to the user’s Visa without first confirming the order-changing action, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. There is no explicit authentication step shown beyond using the provided name/zip, and the agent proceeded to act on an order and payment method without explicit user confirmation. While the requested outcome (exchange to M, blue, high ventilation and quoting the price difference) aligns with user preferences, the lack of confirmation before submitting the exchange and charging the card fails the policy pass bar.
